transcript.text: My father used to tell me, "A focused
fool can accomplish more than a
distracted genius." And so, your most
valuable asset isn't your time, it's
your attention. A man with time and
distractions will always lose to a man
with a deadline and a singular focus.
And so, it's never been easier to be
successful than it is today. It's just
also never been easier to be distracted.
